summary: grade every signal call over a ladder of horizons (3600/900/225s) and let the edge gate select the rung the evidence supports, paying a Bonferroni haircut for the search — the gate was starved rather than wrong, accruing one degree of freedom per hour because a cross-sectional source emits one cohort per measurement horizon; the selected rung drives the gate verdict, the source weights and the holding period alike (ADR-0082)
